description: Gzipped size budgets (KB) for the frontend production bundle, enforced by scripts/track-bundle-size.mjs after `vite build`. Per-chunk budgets guard the named code-split groups from vite.config.ts; the totals guard against unnoticed dependency bloat across all emitted JS/CSS. Budgets are gzipped (what CloudFront transfers) and carry deliberate headroom over observed sizes. Raise a budget only when a chunk grows for a justified reason. The `assets` block budgets unhashed binaries shipped from the dist root (public/) on RAW bytes, since those are already-compressed formats that gzip cannot shrink further. The entry (index) budget was raised from 45 to 55 KB after lazy-loading the chat widget panel (VAL-PERF-013): rolldown merged the previously separate SEO/Icon/hooks shared chunks into the entry, so the entry grew but the total initial JS gzip dropped ~12 KB (191 KB -> 179 KB) and the chat engine is now deferred until the widget opens. The r3f-vendor budget is 135 KB against a measured 118 KB: naming the @react-three group consolidated bytes that previously split between an unnamed chunk (~48 KB) and the lazy mascot/topology consumer chunks, so the first 60 KB guess - taken from the unnamed chunk alone, before rebuilding - was under the chunk's true size. Total JS gzip (1.76 MB) stays well inside the 2100 KB total guard, and the chunk loads lazily with its consumers.
